about: pdufa.bio decision-timing census, FDA actions dated 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Candidates: every PDUFA decision on the pdufa.bio tracked list for those years plus every FDA-released complete response letter dated in those years. Researched and red-teamed 2026-11-26 (four research passes).
